title: IPv6 Summit 2014: Wells Fargo adopting IPv6
summary: Wells Fargo engineers walk through the bank's four-year IPv6 journey at the North American IPv6 Summit 2014. They cover motivation, approach, achievements and observations.
why: HN cites it in IPv6 threads as an example of a large adopter, especially for address-space collisions after mergers and conflicts in 10/8.

quote.text: See this talk from Wells Fargo as an example
